entries.073e700a9e70890b: Its strength lies in a structure that creates products responding to customer needs through a three-way integrated structure linking sales, development and manufacturing, built on its core competencies in microfabrication and high-purity technologies. entries.0b7ae6476dc595ec: This division centers on photosensitive materials such as photoresists.
